result.citation: San Diego Mun. Code § 98.0704 (Ord. O-21647 N.S., as amended through Ord. O-21769 N.S.); see also id. § 98.0706(b)(1), (e)
result.official_quote: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
result.note: Recast the amendment parenthetical as 'as amended through' the latest ordinance shown (O-21769 N.S.) and added see-also cites to § 98.0706(b)(1) and (e), which hold the card's 30/60-day no-fault notice and void-notice rules.
